name: Lavis
source:
Queen of the demon tribe. Because of her great power, she is domineering and arrogant.
She is feared and adored by the demons.
She loves her husband and daughter Roa.
She is sometimes harsh with Roa, but it is out of love for her daughter and because she wants her to grow up strong.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1173186]Getchu[/url]]
